sections.heading: Who folk is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Founders and SMB teams running relationship-led sales from LinkedIn/email.

Avoid if: Phone-first outbound dialer teams.

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with Salesflare on the same job-to-be-done.
